title: Bao Pork Buns
description: A delicious Chinese-inspired dish featuring pork and soft bao buns. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
In a large bowl, combine pork, scallions, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, five-spice powder, salt, and pepper. Mix well until just combined. Do not overmix.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of the pork mixture onto the center of each bao bun.
Steam the buns for 5-7 minutes, or until they are soft and cooked through.
Serve the buns hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Note: You can also pan-fry the bao buns with a small amount of oil until crispy and golden brown.
